title: Lemma 2.3: uniform bound for (delta,s)-supported points in a finite planar set
statement_scope: Whole Lemma supported (lines 475-481): for every δ∈(0,1) there is a constant c=c(δ) such that for every finite C⊂R² and every s≥2, the set of (δ,s)-supported points in C has cardinality at most c|C|/s. The isolation-radius and (δ,s)-supported definitions at lines 457-474 are retained as context.
